scope: Physical Logitech Muse USB configuration and bounded CDC receive capture on macOS; not a BLE HID report-map capture

usbConfiguration.interpretation: This 141-byte configuration contains two CDC control/data pairs and no USB HID interface. It is not a BLE report descriptor.

cdcCapture.controlPlaneOperations: O_RDWR open, raw tty preserving baud, DTR assertion, best-effort restore and close

userInteraction.userConfirmed: Tip and both buttons pressed; USB stayed connected
userInteraction.requestedActions: 3 tip presses, 3 presses of each near-tip button; top button untouched
userInteraction.scope: Human confirmation is not a measured device event

conclusion: No unsolicited CDC bytes were observed from either opened port in this 60.081-second, baud-preserving, explicit-DTR trial while the user confirmed the requested presses. No USB/BLE-wide incompatibility or absent pen input is established. At the time of this CDC capture, the BLE HID report map and raw tip layout were unknown. A subsequent separate test-only descriptor read is recorded in muse-hid-test-descriptor-read.json.
limitations: Opening CDC ports and asserting DTR changes control state; no application commands or firmware payloads were sent.
Human confirmation of presses is not a measured pen event.
REA process ownership verification is scoped to its capture group, not the whole machine. Three platform observations were unverified and left untouched.
Process trees are sampled; filesystem evidence is before/after snapshots, not syscall tracing; network activity and inherited environment were not observed.
privacy: Device serial numbers, full REA environment, process IDs, device-node paths and private filesystem paths omitted
